description: Use once so you never have to poll: registers an https webhook for your wallet and Bull pushes agreement.created (you are the payee), agreement.action_needed (you must attest, vote or may object), agreement.ready, agreement.released and agreement.refunded. Bull also pays out agreements whose conditions are all true and refunds expired ones automatically. Signed call. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

url.description: Public https URL that receives events. Send null/empty to stop.

name: bull_agreement_watch
